note: Hôtel des Voyageurs lobby (ground floor), camera inside the front door looking in. Landmark: the tower of giant stacked suitcases beside the staircase. Feminine LEFT: grandma explorer in a red pedal van with a map (aventure), girl pointing at a pin on the globe (destination), goat on holiday in a deckchair (vacance). Centre: tourist with a parrot on each shoulder (touriste, m/f). Masculine RIGHT: tortoise setting off with a suitcase on its shell (voyage), weary traveller with a sticker-covered case (voyageur), goat in a sun hat at the postcard stand (tourisme), visitor in a pith helmet tickling the bell with a feather (visiteur). Exits: front door (far left) -> B22_hotel; staircase up -> R_hotel_02; zoom on the reception desk (key rack) -> R_hotel_01_z1. Painted 2026-10-22.
